scripts.test:api:legal:ssl: npm set NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 && npx playwright test -c API-Tests/playwright.config.ts API-Tests/tests/eq-legal-collection

scripts.test:api:examples:ssl: npm set NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 && npx playwright test -c API-Tests/playwright.config.ts API-Tests/examples

scripts.test:slow: HEADLESS=false SLOW_MO=1000 npx playwright test -c API-Tests/playwright.config.ts
